      "source": [

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "x_train,x_test,y_train,y_test=(train_test_split(\n",
        "    iris_data,\n",
        "    iris_labels,\n",
        "    test_size=0.20,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        "))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "KCcmCcgnIqv9"
      },
      "execution_count": 13,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "classifier=KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=6)\n",
        "classifier.fit(x_train,y_train)\n",
        "y_pred=classifier.predict(x_test)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "nqrYbo3YJD13"
      },
      "execution_count": 14,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "print(\"accuracy is\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test,y_pred))"
      ],
